CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:
1. Region is Melawi Regency.
2. Regional Government is the Regent as the Element of Regional Government Administrator who leads the Implementation of Government Affairs that are the Authority of the Autonomous Region.
3. Regent is the Regent of Melawi.
4. Regional Secretary is the Regional Secretary of Melawi Regency.
5. Regional Apparatus is the supporting element of the regional head and DPRD in the administration of Government Affairs that are the authority of the Region.
6. Women are human beings of female sex starting from infants, adolescents, adults up to the elderly.
7. Women with Disabilities are women who have self-limitations, which can be physical, cognitive, mental, sensory, emotional, developmental or some combination of these.
8. Elderly Women are women who have reached 60 years of age and above.
9. Violence is any act that results in or may result in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, economic, social and psychological to the victim.
10. Violence against women is any act that results in or may result in misery or suffering to women physically, sexually, economically, socially, psychologically including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in public or private life.
11. Victim...
women who experience misery and/or
11. Victim is a woman who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence and life vulnerability.
12. Protection of Women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the regional government, community, and/or other parties who know or hear that violence against women is about to occur or has occurred.
13. Service/handling is an action taken as soon as possible to the victim when seeing, hearing and/or knowing that violence against the victim is occurring or has occurred.
14. Companion is a person or representative of an institution who has the expertise to provide assistance to victims to conduct counseling/therapy and/or advocacy.
15. Integrated Service Center, hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, is an institution or functional work unit that organizes integrated services for victims of violence.
16. Safe House is a residence for victims during the assistance process for the safety and comfort of victims from threats and dangers.
17. Minimum Service Standards, hereinafter abbreviated as SPM, is a performance benchmark for integrated service units in providing 5 (five) types of services for women and children victims of violence, namely (1) Complaint Handling (2) Health Services (3) Social Rehabilitation (4) Law Enforcement and Legal Aid, and (5) Repatriation and Social Reintegration.
18. Complaint Handling is a series of actions taken by integrated service providers to follow up on reports of acts of violence against women submitted by victims, families and the community.
19. Health Services are efforts that include promotive, preventive, curative and rehabilitative aspects.
20. Social Rehabilitation is a service aimed at restoring and developing the ability of a person experiencing social dysfunction so that they can perform their social functions properly.
21. Law Enforcement is an action by officials authorized by the state to implement laws and regulations.
22. Legal Aid is legal services provided by legal companions and advocacy to conduct the process of accompanying witnesses and/or victims of violence against women.
23. Repatriation is an effort to return women victims of violence from abroad to the debarkation point/entry point, or from the receiving area to the area of origin.
24. Social Reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with family, substitute family, or community that can provide protection and fulfillment for victims.
25. Integrated Service Unit or abbreviated as UPT is a unified unit that organizes integrated service functions for women victims of violence.
26. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband-wife and their children or father and children, or mother and children, or blood relatives in direct line upward or downward.
27. Household...
actions that have
27. Household is husband, wife and children, people who have family relations due to blood relations, marriage, breastfeeding, care and guardianship and/or domestic workers who reside in that household.

a. acts that neglect women within the scope of their household, and/or
b. acts that result in economic dependence.

Article 19
Exploitation as referred to in Article 14 letter e includes:
a. actions that exploit women economically or sexually with the intention of benefiting oneself or others.
b. actions with or without the consent of the victim which include but are not limited to prostitution, forced labor or services, slavery or similar practices, oppression, extortion, utilization of physical, sexual, reproductive organs, or unlawfully removing or transplanting organs and/or body tissues or exploiting the labor or capabilities of a person by another party to obtain benefits both material and immaterial.
c. all forms of utilization of sexual organs or other body organs of the victim to obtain benefits, including but not limited to all activities of prostitution or sexual abuse.

Article 20

b. a situation where a person/victim is ordered to do something in such a way that the person does something against their own will.

BAB VII
PUSAT PELAYANAN TERPADU
Pasal 26
(1) PPT dapat dibentuk oleh instansi vertikal di daerah pemerintah Daerah,  pemerintah kabupaten/kota, dan/atau Lembaga masyarakat.  (2) PPT sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) terdiri dari unsur Kepolisian  Daerah, SKPD yang membidangi Kesehatan, Pendidikan, Sosial,  Pemberdayaan Masyarakat, Pemberdayaan Perempuan dan Perlindungan  Anak serta Lembaga Sosial Masyarakat, yang fungsi memberikan  perlindungan kepada perempuan dari tindak kekerasan yang dilakukan  secara berjejaring.
(3) pelayanan dan perlindungan sementara berupa rumah aman (shelter)  bagi korban.
(4) Dalam hal PPT tidak memiliki rumah aman sebagaiman dimaksud pada  ayat (3), maka korban dirujuk pada PPT yang memiliki rumah aman.  (5) Ketentuan lebih lanjut mengenai Struktur Organisasi PPT diatur dengan  Peraturan Bupati.
translated_text:
CHAPTER VII
INTEGRATED SERVICE CENTER
Article 26
(1) The PPT may be established by vertical agencies in the regional government, district/city government, and/or community institutions.
(2) The PPT as referred to in paragraph (1) consists of elements from the Regional Police, SKPD responsible for Health, Education, Social Affairs, Community Empowerment, Women's Empowerment and Child Protection as well as Community Social Institutions, which function to provide protection to women from acts of violence carried out in a networked manner.
(3) temporary services and protection in the form of a safe house (shelter) for victims.
(4) In the event that the PPT does not have a safe house as referred to in paragraph (3), then the victim shall be referred to a PPT that has a safe house.
(5) Further provisions regarding the Organizational Structure of the PPT shall be regulated by Regent Regulation.

( 1) Masyarakat berperan serta dalam penyelenggaraan perlindungan
a. membentuk mitra keluarga ditingkat elur masyarakat; dalam organisasi  b. membentuk unit perlindungan perempuan kemasyarakatan; . .
c. melakukan sosialisai hak perempuan secara mandiri,

e. melakukan pertolongan pertama pada korban; dan
f. melaporkan kepada instansi yang berwenang apabila dilingkungannya  terjadi kekerasan terhadap perempuan.
(3) Peran serta masyarakat sebagaiman dimaksud pada ayat (1) dapat  dilakukan oleh perorangan lembaga sosial kemasyarakatan, lembaga  swadaya masyarakat, lembaga pendidikan, lembaga keagamaan, swasta,  dan/ atau media massa.

BAB XI

Pasal 30
(1) Pemerintah Daerah melakukan pembinaan dan pengawasan terhadap  pelaksanaan perlindungan perempuan.
(2) Pembinaan dan pengawasan sebagaiman dimaksud pada ayat (1)  meliputi:
a. koordinasi;
b. bimbingan;
c. pendidikan dan pelatihan; dan
d. pemantauan dan evaluasi.
(3) Koordinasi sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (2) huruf a rnencakup  perencanaan dan pelaksanaan.
(4) Bimbingan sebagaimana dimaksud sebagaimana pada ayat (2) huruf b  mencakup perencanaan, pelaksanaan, tatalaksana, pendanaan, kualitas,  pengendalian, dan pengawasan.
(5) Pendidikan dan pelatihan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (2) huruf c  dilakukan sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan. CHAPTER XI
GUIDANCE AND SUPERVISION
Article 30
(1) Regional Government conducts guidance and supervision of the implementation of women's protection.
(2) Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) includes:
a. coordination;
b. guidance;
c. education and training; and
d. monitoring and evaluation.
(3) Coordination as referred to in paragraph (2) letter a encompasses planning and implementation.
(4) Guidance as referred to in paragraph (2) letter b encompasses planning, implementation, procedures, financing, quality, control, and supervision.
(5) Education and training as referred to in paragraph (2) letter c shall be conducted in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.
(6) Monitoring and evaluation as referred to in paragraph (2) letter d shall be conducted based on the provisions of laws and regulations periodically every 6 (six) months.

I. UMUM
PENJELASAN ATAS
PERATURAN DAERAH KABUPATEN MELAWI
NOMOR 15 TAHUN 2017
TENTANG
PENYELENGGARAAN PERLINDUNGAN PEREMPUAN  DARI TINDAK KEKERASAN Tindak kekerasan terhadap perempuan merupakan pelanggaran hak asazi manusia sehingga, perlu dilindungi harga diri dan martabatnya  serta dijamin hak hidupnya sesuai dengan fitrah dan kodratnya tanpa  diskriminasi.
Dalam rangka mencegah dan menanggulangi kekerasan terhadap  perempuan di Kabupaten Melawi agar terhindar dari kekerasan,  ancanaman kekerasan, penyiksaan atau perlakuan yang merendahkan  derajat dan martabat kemanusiaan, perlu dibentuk peraturan daerah  perlindungan perempuan.
Perlindungan perempuan merupakan segala upaya yang ditujukan  untuk melindungi perempuan dan memberikan rasa aman dalam  pemenuhan hak-haknya dengan memberikan perhatian yang konsisten  dan sitematis.
Peraturan perundang-undangan yang ada atau yang terkait  dengan mengenai perlindungan perempuan korban kekerasan belum  mengatur upaya perlindungan perempuan di daerah, sehingga  diperlukan dukungan kelembagaan dan peraturan di tingkat daerah yang  dapat menjamin pelaksanaannya.
Peraturan Daerah ini mengatur upaya perlindungan perempuan  kh ususnya dalam bentuk pencegahan, pelayanan/penanganan, dan  pemberdayaan terhadap perempuan di Kabupaten M 1 . e.aw1.
translated_text:
I. GENERAL
ELUCIDATION OF
REGIONAL REGULATION OF MELAWI REGENCY
NUMBER 15 OF 2017
CONCERNING
THE IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION OF WOMEN FROM ACTS OF VIOLENCE

Acts of violence against women constitute a violation of human rights therefore, their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women in Melawi Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to establish a regional regulation on the protection of women.

The protection of women constitutes all efforts aimed at protecting women and providing a sense of security in the fulfillment of their rights by giving consistent and systematic attention.

Existing laws and regulations or those related to the protection of women victims of violence have not yet regulated efforts to protect women in the regions, therefore institutional support and regulations at the regional level are needed that can guarantee their implementation.

This Regional Regulation regulates efforts to protect women specifically in the form of prevention, services/handling, and empowerment of women in Melawi Regency.

What is meant by efforts from the Promotive aspect is the effort to promote/socialize about acts of violence to the community, with the aim of increasing public awareness and sensitivity to the danger of violence threatening women.
What is meant by efforts from the Preventive aspect is efforts that prioritize the prevention aspect with targets being communities vulnerable to becoming victims of violence and receiving its impact. Preventive efforts can be carried out through community empowerment in the form of training activities and others.
What is meant by efforts from the Curative aspect is efforts carried out in the form of handling victims of violence who need handling according to their needs, namely health rehabilitation handling if the victim suffers the impact of violence physically or psychologically, provision of assistance and law enforcement for victims who require assistance and law enforcement and so forth.
What is meant by the Rehabilitative aspect is efforts carried out as an effort to recover victims of violence both physically, psychologically and psychosocially.
